description: Searches the workspace's mentions. You can filter by keyword, platform, status (open, ignored, done), relevant, minimum relevance, minimum confidence (0 to 1), sentiment, intent, text (q, in the post or the author's name) and time range (ISO 8601). You can also filter by one person (personId from list_people), assignee (assigneeId), author followers (minFollowers, maxFollowers), engagement counts from the platform (minLikes, minReposts, minReplies, minQuotes, minViews, minBookmarks, where posts without that count are left out), review stars (ratings, or notRatings to exclude some), author tags (tags, any of them), linked hosts (linkHosts, a host or its subdomains), replies or not (isReply), and machine-made posts (automated true or false). alertId applies an alert's whole filter, giving the mentions it would send. viewId applies a saved view from list_views on top of the rest. keywordKinds filters by the kind of keyword that matched (brand, competitor, topic), and groupIds or notGroupIds by the keyword's group (ids from list_groups). All filters are joined by AND. For OR, anyOf takes up to 10 groups of the same conditions, each an object whose conditions are joined by AND, and keeps a mention when one group matches as well as the rest. For example anyOf=[{platforms:["github"],intents:["bug_report"]},{sentiments:["negative"]}]. Snoozed mentions are hidden unless snoozed=true. sort is "newest" (the default) or "priority", an attention score built from relevance, author reach, intent and age that covers only the past 30 days of matches and comes on each mention as `priority`. Returns 10 mentions by default, up to 100 with limit. Each mention contains post, author, classification and triage.

alertId.description: Adds an alert rule's filter (an id from GET /v1/alerts) to the other filters. You get the mentions the rule would send, useful for a preview or an export in feed form. An unknown id returns 404.

anyOf.description: Up to 10 OR'd groups (at least 1). A mention must meet every condition of some group, plus all other conditions, so the filter reads (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). Groups take view filter fields (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists and so on) but no nested anyOf.

items.description: A set of conditions that must all be true. It uses the same fields as a view filter, except anyOf.

automated.description: true keeps posts that look machine-made. false keeps the others.

excludeAuthors.description: Leaves out these authors, given as display names, handles or profile links.

groupIds.description: Limits to keywords from these groups (grp_...).

intents.description: Keeps mentions tagged with one of these intents or topics.

isReply.description: true keeps replies and comments. false keeps posts that are not replies.

keywordIds.description: Keeps matches of these keywords only.

keywordKinds.description: Keyword kinds to keep, out of brand, competitor and topic.

kind.description: Only posts (post) or only comments (comment: replies, comments and answers). repository (GitHub repository events) is accepted and matches nothing, since Rumoro does not collect them. Omitted: all.

languages.description: Keeps posts in these languages only, as ISO 639-1 codes.

linkHosts.description: Keeps posts that link to one of these hosts or its subdomains.

maxFollowers.description: Keeps authors with this many followers or fewer. Unknown counts are left out.

minBookmarks.description: Keeps posts with this many bookmarks (saves) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a bookmark count are left out.

minConfidence.description: Keeps mentions whose classifier confidence is this value or higher.

minFollowers.description: Keeps authors with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out.

minLikes.description: Keeps posts with this many likes (upvotes, reactions) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a like count are left out.

minQuotes.description: Keeps posts with this many quotes or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a quote count are left out.

minRelevance.description: Minimum relevance score a mention needs.

minReplies.description: Keeps posts with this many replies (comments) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a reply count are left out.

minReposts.description: Keeps posts with this many reposts (shares, retweets) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a repost count are left out.

minViews.description: Keeps posts with this many views (plays) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a view count are left out.

notGroupIds.description: Hides matches from keywords that belong to these groups.

notLanguages.description: Leaves out posts in these languages. Posts with an unknown language are kept.

notLinkHosts.description: Leaves out posts that link to these hosts.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

notRatings.description: Hides reviews with these star ratings. Other posts are not affected.

notSentiments.description: Hides these sentiments. Unscored mentions stay.

notTags.description: Leaves out authors with one of these tags.

platforms.description: Keeps posts from these platforms only.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

q.description: Searches post text and author names.

ratings.description: Keeps reviews with one of these star ratings. Posts that are not reviews are left out.

relevant.description: Filter on the classifier's verdict. true keeps relevant mentions, false the rest.

sentiments.description: Keeps mentions with these sentiments only.

status.description: Keeps mentions with this status only (open, ignored or done).

tags.description: Keeps authors your workspace gave one of these tags.

assigneeId.description: Member user id. Returns only mentions assigned to them.

automated.description: true keeps mentions that look machine-made, such as bot accounts, scheduled or template posts and AI-written text. false keeps the others, including mentions scored before this flag existed. Leave it out for all.

excludeAuthors.description: Leaves out these authors, given as display names, handles or profile links. Repeat the parameter or send one value with commas.

groupIds.description: Keeps matches of keywords in these groups only (grp_...). Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

includeMuted.description: true also returns mentions by muted people, which are hidden by default.

intent.description: Returns only mentions with this tag. One of bug_report, buy_intent, churn_intent, comparison, complaint, event, feedback, hiring, industry_insight, launch, praise, pricing, promotional, question and testimonial.

intents.description: Keeps mentions tagged with one of these intents or topics.

isReply.description: true keeps replies and comments, meaning posts that answer another post. false keeps posts that are not replies. Leave it out for both.

keywordIds.description: Keeps matches of these keywords only.

keywordKinds.description: Keeps matches of keywords of these kinds only (brand, competitor, topic). Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

kind.description: Only posts (post) or only comments (comment: replies, comments and answers). repository (GitHub repository events) is accepted and matches nothing, since Rumoro does not collect them. Omitted: all.

languages.description: Sends only posts in these languages, as ISO 639-1 codes such as en, es or de. Posts with an unknown language are left out.

limit.description: How many mentions to return, from 1 to 100. The default is 10, so narrow the filters before you ask for more.

linkHosts.description: Keeps posts that link to one of these hosts or its subdomains, so slack.com also matches api.slack.com. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

maxFollowers.description: Keeps posts by authors with this many followers or fewer. Unknown counts are left out.

minBookmarks.description: Keeps posts with this many bookmarks (saves) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a bookmark count are left out.

minConfidence.description: Minimum classifier confidence, 0 to 1. Mentions with no confidence are dropped.

minFollowers.description: Sends only posts by authors with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out.

minLikes.description: Keeps posts with this many likes (upvotes, reactions) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a like count are left out.

minQuotes.description: Keeps posts with this many quotes or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a quote count are left out.

minRelevance.description: Keeps mentions with this relevance score or higher. Unscored mentions are left out.

minReplies.description: Keeps posts with this many replies (comments) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a reply count are left out.

minReposts.description: Keeps posts with this many reposts (shares, retweets) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a repost count are left out.

minViews.description: Keeps posts with this many views (plays) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a view count are left out.

notGroupIds.description: Hides matches from keywords that belong to these groups.

notIntents.description: Intent or topic tags to exclude.

notLanguages.description: Leaves out posts in these languages. Posts with an unknown language are kept.

notLinkHosts.description: Leaves out posts that link to these hosts or their subdomains.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

notRatings.description: Star ratings (1 to 5) to hide, such as notRatings=5. Other posts are unaffected.

notSentiments.description: Leaves out these sentiments. Mentions not scored yet are kept.

notTags.description: Leaves out authors your workspace gave one of these tags.

personId.description: Keeps mentions by this person (an id from /v1/people), including merged accounts. Turns on includeMuted.

platforms.description: Keeps posts from these platforms only.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

q.description: Searches post text and author names.

ratings.description: Keeps reviews with one of these star ratings, from 1 to 5. Use ratings=1,2 for the unhappy ones. Posts that are not reviews are left out.

relevant.description: true keeps mentions the classifier scored relevant. false keeps the others, including unscored ones.

sentiment.description: Keeps mentions with this sentiment only.

sentiments.description: Keeps mentions with these sentiments only.

since.description: Keeps posts published at this time or later, as ISO 8601 or epoch ms.

snoozed.description: true shows only snoozed mentions, which are otherwise hidden until they wake.

sort.description: newest orders by match time, latest first. priority orders by attention score, highest first, and only covers the past 30 days of matches. Older ones are still available with newest. A cursor only works with the sort it came from.

status.description: Keeps mentions with this status only. Leave it out for all statuses.

tags.description: Keeps authors your workspace gave one of these tags, matched exactly and by case. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

until.description: Keeps posts published at this time or earlier, as ISO 8601 or epoch ms.

viewId.description: Adds a saved view's filter (an id from GET /v1/views) to the other filters, with every condition joined by AND. You get exactly what the view shows. An unknown id returns 404.
